facts.fact_text: At the material time, the first applicant was a member of the Popular Front Party of Azerbaijan, one of the opposition parties.
The first applicant participated in a number of peaceful demonstrations organised by the opposition.
All three applicants participated in the demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013.
After the end of the demonstration of 12 October 2013, the applicants were arrested at the entrance to a nearby metro station called Inshaatchilar.
The circumstances of the applicants' arrests are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).
The circumstances of the applicants' custody are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).

The circumstances of the subsequent administrative proceedings against the applicants are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).
The circumstances of the applicants' arrests are similar to those in Huseynov and Others v. Azerbaijan (Committee, application nos. 34262/14 and 5 others, judgment of 24 November 2016).
The circumstances of the applicants' custody are similar to those in Huseynov and Others v. Azerbaijan (Committee, application nos. 34262/14 and 5 others, judgment of 24 November 2016).

The circumstances of the subsequent administrative proceedings against the applicants are similar to those in Huseynov and Others v. Azerbaijan (Committee, application nos. 34262/14 and 5 others, judgment of 24 November 2016).
